name: Charlotte Vaasa
original_name: シャルロット・ヴァーサ
source:
Charlotte is also a princess but she's from Vaasa country (or something like that). Charlotte is pretty clumsy but she's very good at pouring tea and cooking. She really loves getting praised by the protagonist. Charlotte prefers to be called Charl and she's surprisingly good at fighting when she wants to be.

[Edited from [url=http://liemyx.livejournal.com/1263.html]Liemyx's review[/url].]
